audit.summary: Both P0 fixes are correct. All five proofs reproduce on ephemeral PostgreSQL 16. No blocking findings. Three non-blocking observations documented below.

checks.description: Migration file exists at expected path
checks.detail: Found at supabase/migrations/20260812000000_tutor_messages_idempotency_role.sql (not infra/supabase/migrations/ — monorepo layout uses top-level supabase/)
server/services/tutor-runtime-writer.ts contains P0-1 typed values and assignmentId return

checks.description: tutor-runtime.ts present and modified at step 12 call site
checks.detail: server/routes/tutor-runtime.ts step 12 call at lines 911-931 uses new values
docs/Spec/Doc-03A_V3.0.md and docs/Spec/Doc-03B_V4.1.md both readable; §18.4 CHECK constraints and §13.3 two-row model verified

detail.notes: Doc-03A §11 defines policy families. §18.4 defines tutor_instruction_assignments DDL with CHECK constraints. Doc-03B §6.5 step 12 is 'Persist instructional assignment'. INV-03-11 is the invariant tag. All citations resolve to correct spec content.
§18.2 defines tutor_messages DDL (contains the spec defect: UNIQUE without role). §9 defines the two-row model. §13.3 defines idempotent recovery via client_turn_id. All citations accurate.

columns_verified.source: Doc-03A_V3.0 §18.4 lines 1967-1968; default confirmed at Doc-03B:3470 misc.default_policy_variant = '"scaffolded"'
Doc-03A_V3.0 §18.4 lines 1969-1970; code at tutor-runtime-writer.ts:75-77 conditionally omits the field

blocking_write_verified.evidence: tutor-runtime-writer.ts returns { ok: false } on failure; tutor-runtime.ts lines 933-942 check ok===false and return 500, halting the turn. Matches Doc-03B §1.4: 'policy-assignment persistence is blocking for every turn'.

assignment_id_reaches_step_18.detail: assignmentId is captured via destructuring but never referenced in the step 18 exposure insert (lines 1085-1109). See non-blocking finding NB-1.

drop_targets_correct_name.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tutor_messages_client_turn_idempotency ON public.tutor_messages (student_id, conversation_id, client_turn_id) WHERE client_turn_id IS NOT NULL

new_index.detail: Each (student_id, conversation_id, client_turn_id) can have exactly one role='student' row and one role='tutor' row, matching Doc-03B §9 and §13.3.

scl_028_accuracy.detail: SCL-028 accurately records: §18.2 defines UNIQUE(conversation_id, client_turn_id), which contradicts the two-row model in §9/§13.3. Status: PROPOSED. The described defect is real — the spec's uniqueness key lacks role.

transaction_safety.detail: Migration wrapped in BEGIN/COMMIT. DROP IF EXISTS is idempotent. CREATE UNIQUE INDEX will fail if duplicate (role-unaware) rows already exist in prod — but tutor_messages is new (created in the same migration set) so no pre-existing violating data.

proofs.title: Old policy_variant 'standard' violates CHECK
proofs.result: ERROR: new row for relation "tutor_instruction_assignments" violates check constraint "tutor_instruction_assignments_policy_variant_check"

proofs.title: Omitting emotional_register gets DB DEFAULT 'default'
proofs.command: INSERT INTO tutor_instruction_assignments (omitting emotional_register) then SELECT emotional_register

proofs.title: 3-column index blocks second (tutor) row for same client_turn_id
proofs.command: INSERT student row (OK), then INSERT tutor row with same (student_id, conversation_id, client_turn_id) but role='tutor'
proofs.result: ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "idx_tutor_messages_client_turn_idempotency"
proofs.detail: This is the P0-2 bug: the 3-column index treats both roles as duplicates

proofs.title: 4-column index permits both student and tutor rows
proofs.command: DROP old 3-col index, CREATE new 4-col index with role, re-insert both rows
proofs.detail: After applying the migration fix, both role='student' and role='tutor' rows coexist for the same client_turn_id

genesis_snapshot.description: Exactly one line changed: btree index column list updated from (student_id, conversation_id, client_turn_id) to (student_id, conversation_id, client_turn_id, role). No other objects added, removed, or modified.

detail.detail: Grep for LISA-FULL-002 through LISA-FULL-011 across all changed files returned no matches. No audit findings from the prior LISA-FULL series are partially addressed or regressed by this PR.

non_blocking_findings.summary: assignmentId captured but never wired to step 18 exposure insert
non_blocking_findings.detail: Line 931 destructures assignmentId from the writer result. The step 18 exposure insert (lines 1085-1109) does not reference it. The annotation on the writer documents intent ('return assignment id for step 18 exposure FK'), so this is a known incomplete wiring, not an oversight. Non-blocking because the assignment row IS persisted (the blocking write succeeds); only the FK from exposure → assignment is deferred.
non_blocking_findings.action: Wire assignmentId into the step 18 insert payload in a follow-up PR

non_blocking_findings.detail: chat.tsx and api-error.ts add premium-upgrade and error-notice UX. They are self-contained and low-risk, but are unrelated to either P0 fix. Consider splitting into a separate PR for cleaner audit trail.
non_blocking_findings.action: Optional — split into separate PR or accept as-is
